title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
Performance Marketing Specialist

**Company:** NVPL / YadaSutra Ayurveda  
**Location:** Head Office, Ernakulam, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Permanent  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Department:** Marketing  
**Level:** Level 2  
**Reports To:** Marketing Coordinator / Head – Marketing

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and data\-driven **Performance Marketing Specialist** to manage and optimize paid digital marketing campaigns for the **YadaSutra Ayurveda** brand.

The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with **Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads, and other digital advertising platforms**, with a strong focus on lead generation, conversion, cost optimization, and ROI.

The candidate will work closely with the marketing, creative, CRM/CRE, branch operations, and external agency teams to ensure that digital campaigns deliver measurable business results.

Key ResponsibilitiesCampaign Management

* Plan, set up, launch, and manage paid campaigns across **Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube**, and relevant marketplace platforms.
* Develop monthly media plans based on business, branch, and product targets.
* Manage audience targeting, keywords, placements, and campaign structures.
* Conduct **A/B testing** of creatives, ad copies, audiences, landing pages, and bidding strategies.
* Plan campaigns around promotions, seasonal demand, treatment packages, and product launches.

Budget \& Performance Optimization

* Manage and allocate monthly advertising budgets across campaigns and platforms.
* Monitor **CPL, CPA, qualified leads, conversion rates, and ROAS**.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and optimize budgets to improve performance.
* Track campaign spending and identify opportunities for scaling successful campaigns.
* Support Finance with monthly advertising spend documentation and reconciliation.

Analytics \& Reporting

* Set up and monitor conversion tracking using **Meta Pixel, Google Ads conversion tracking, GA4, GTM**, and UTM parameters.
* Ensure accurate tracking of leads from ad click through consultation or sale.
* Prepare **weekly dashboards and monthly performance reports**.
* Analyse the complete marketing funnel and identify areas for improving lead\-to\-consultation conversion.
* Provide data\-driven insights and recommendations to the management team.

Creative \& Landing Page Coordination

* Work with designers, content creators, videographers, and agencies to develop high\-performing ad creatives.
* Provide creative briefs, messaging ideas, formats, and campaign requirements.
* Review campaign creatives for platform compliance and brand consistency.
* Coordinate with the web team to improve landing pages and conversion rates.
* Maintain a record of tested creatives, offers, and campaign performance.

Coordination \& Compliance

* Coordinate with external media and creative agencies and monitor their campaign deliverables.
* Work with branch teams to align campaign locations, offers, and appointment capacity.
* Ensure digital advertising follows applicable **ASCI, AYUSH, healthcare advertising, and platform advertising guidelines**.
* Maintain proper records of campaign approvals, creative approvals, and advertising budgets.

Qualifications \& Experience

* Bachelor's degree in **Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field**.
* **2–5 years of hands\-on experience in Performance Marketing / Paid Digital Marketing**.
* Proven experience managing paid advertising campaigns and digital media budgets.
* Experience in **healthcare, wellness, Ayurveda, clinic, D2C, or consumer\-focused businesses** will be an advantage.
* Google Ads and Meta certifications are preferred.

Required Technical Skills

* Advanced knowledge of **Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads**.
* Experience with **Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)** and **Google Tag Manager (GTM)**.
* Knowledge of **Looker Studio** or similar reporting/dashboard tools.
* Strong understanding of lead generation, conversion tracking, audience targeting, bidding, and campaign optimization.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills for campaign analysis and reporting.
* Knowledge of CRM and lead\-management systems.
* Experience with marketplace advertising such as **Amazon, Flipkart, or quick\-commerce platforms** is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of landing pages and **Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)**.

Working Conditions

* Full\-time position based at **Head Office, Ernakulam**.
* Occasional travel to **Kakkanad, Trivandrum, Edappally, and Edappal branches** may be required.
* Flexibility to monitor campaigns during major launches and promotional periods.

Pay: ₹38,076\.85 \- ₹50,003\.24 per month

Work Location: In person
